methods.label: Equalizing the numbers
methods.explanation: Make the numbers equal by transferring \(2\) from \(9\) to \(5\), giving \(7,7,7\). The total and the number of entries stay the same, so the mean stays the same. Since all three new numbers equal \(7\), the original mean is \(7\).
methods.levelReason: Equalizing uses the Grade 4 equal-sharing meaning of the mean and addition and subtraction within 10.
